decision: docs/ROADMAP.md area E (a8423e5): adopt share: in haematopoiesis.to_bio with the growth re-solved for 1 - sum(f), as its own registered lane
stop_list: not on the 2026-09-27 stop list (docs/ROADMAP.md section 5): this is the human haematopoiesis module, not the worm's fate ceiling
prior_measurement: lane-tobioshare (2026-10-10, no commit): same numbers as share: collapse the pools (CMP 0.13 of solved, wild-type asserts fail); growth re-solved for 1 - sum(f): 16 of 44 growth numbers move by up to +2.2%, every assert and the nine mutants pass, pools 1.038-1.04 of solved at 3 yr (Monocyte 0.9075 -> 1.0401 against today's generator); single-child flows identical as share:. Its trajectories between 0 d and 3 yr were not read for this registration.

change.plan: plan() solves each compartment's growth step for the share rule: (1 + g) * (1 - sum(f_i)) = 1 - o / A, where the f_i are the per-step outflow fractions to the children and o / A the share the inflow supplies (HSC: (1 + g) * (1 - f) = 1), replacing (1 + g) * prod(1 - f_i). The Fill-stage steps divide by the same retained term, so they move with it.
change.to_bio: the eight sibling-partition flows (a parent with two children) are written as `share:` with the same numbers: CLP_to_ProB, CLP_to_Thymocyte, CMP_to_GMP, CMP_to_MEP, GMP_to_Monoblast, GMP_to_Myeloblast, MPP_to_CLP, MPP_to_CMP
change.unchanged: single-child flows (HSC_to_MPP, MEP_to_Erythroblast, the five terminal-to-mature flows) stay `fraction:` with their numbers; the five mature losses, every name, every evidence string, haematopoiesis_mutants.bio and haematopoiesis_designs.bio are byte-identical
change.expected_diff: exactly the 8 partition lines change key (value identical) and exactly the 16 divide numbers of the four branching compartments change value: CLP_amplify, CLP_fill_10pc, CLP_fill_1pc, CLP_fill_2x, CMP_amplify, CMP_fill_10pc, CMP_fill_1pc, CMP_fill_2x, GMP_amplify, GMP_fill_10pc, GMP_fill_1pc, GMP_fill_2x, MPP_amplify, MPP_fill_10pc, MPP_fill_1pc, MPP_fill_2x; a single-child compartment keeps 1 - f = prod(1 - f), so its numbers cannot move. A diff of any other shape is not the registered change and is not adopted.
change.regenerated_by: to_bio() and mutants_bio(), the functions genomeos/storage.py's human_cell_turnover distiller calls, written to the two program files (the distiller itself also refetches Sender & Milo and rewrites tissues.bio, which this change does not touch)

criteria.a: every wild-type assert of haematopoiesis.bio (3) and every assert of all nine experiments of haematopoiesis_mutants.bio (36) passes
criteria.b: wild type: every compartment's pool within +-5% of its solved value (plan()[id]['pool']) at every sample of the Steady stage (from 90 d, the program's own stage boundary) every 30 days to 1080 d and at 3 yr: 35 samples x 11 compartments. 'Compartment' is read as the module's COMPARTMENTS (HSC through Thymocyte), the cell types whose pool plan() solves. The five mature types are reported at 3 yr against output x lifespan but are not in (b): they approach it with their lifespan as time constant (TCell 320 d), so no generator puts them within 5% from 90 d; the wild-type asserts test three of them at 3 yr. Fill-stage samples (0 to 60 d) are reported, not judged.
criteria.c: every growth number (the `fraction:` of every `action: divide` decision, 44 in all) that changes is listed old -> new with its relative change, and each is named as fitted: it must sit on a decision whose evidence tier is `inferred` (none sourced). Holds when the list is complete and no changed number is on a curated or experimental decision.
criteria.d: every committed result or reading that depends on the module (listed under `dependents`, identified before the change) is measured before (this file) and after (the result), and every change is listed.
criteria.e: falsifier: any wild-type assert or mutant assert failing, or any compartment sample outside +-5% in (b), or a diff that is not the registered change, means the change is NOT adopted and the generator is restored to its committed state.

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments
revision_stamps.reading: no revision race: both stamps record e08f7bc

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
